BREAKING: SpaceX has once again broken the record for the tallest rocket ever built.

For the third time in just three years, a new version of Starship has been stacked at Starbase in South Texas near the US-Mexico border.

Starship V3 is larger and more powerful than previous generations, continuing SpaceX’s rapid pace of iteration as it pushes toward full reusability and deep space missions.

The scale of development happening at Starbase is unlike anything the modern space industry has seen.
